title: VeilGrade
description: Simple color grading using Veil's post-processing functionality.
body:
Veil Grade let's you have simple color post processing for your modpack or whatever, to configure the mod look for the config "veilgrade-client.toml", you can adjust saturation, contrast, vignette, and color temperature.

Because Veil is awesome, changes made in the config are applied immediately, no reloading or game restart required, can also be configured in create settings menu.

**!THIS MOD WAS MADE USING AI!**
